letterContent: Every storm runs out of rain, just like every argument reminds me how much I value our warmth.
I hate being on opposite sides of the storm. Let the dark clouds pass and let's welcome the sunshine back into our days.
I'm right here waiting with an umbrella and an open heart.

scratchCard.title: ✦ CLEAR THE RAIN CLOUDS ✦
scratchCard.hiddenText: Sunny Forecast: 1x Cozy Coffee Date + Warm Hugs All Day! ☕

runawayQuestion.question: Will you let the sun shine between us again?
runawayQuestion.successMessage: The storm is over! Thank you for letting the sun back in! ☀️❤
